mcp_desc: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code or any other MCP client to your full playbook library — prompts and skills — and to your personas.
mcp_locked_title: MCP access requires Team or Business
mcp_locked_body: Upgrade your plan to connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients.
mcp_prompt_body: This is the same instruction the sqemes chat already works under. A connected AI tool follows it only when it is in your own standing instructions — without it, the tool checks your playbooks when you ask it to, and rarely on its own. Add it where your AI tool keeps its instructions, and it applies to everyone at once.
mcp_just_you_where: ChatGPT → Settings → Personalization → Custom instructions. Claude → Settings → your own instructions.
mcp_everyone_where: on Claude Team or Enterprise an admin can set it under Organization and access, and it then applies to every conversation in the organisation. ChatGPT has no documented setting that reaches every chat; a shared Skill is the closest, and it is applied when the model judges it relevant.

mcpc_claude_1: In Claude (web or desktop app): Customize → Connectors → + Add → Add custom connector.
mcpc_claude_2: Name it "sqemes" and paste the endpoint URL above. Continue.
mcpc_claude_3: Choose to sign in, then sign in with your sqemes account and pick the workspace.
mcpc_claude_note: On Claude Team or Enterprise an owner adds the connector once under Organization settings → Connectors → Add → Custom → Web; everyone then connects it under Customize → Connectors.
mcpc_chatgpt_1: Open chatgpt.com/plugins, select the plus button, then Add custom MCP server.
mcpc_chatgpt_2: Name it "sqemes" and paste the endpoint URL above.
mcpc_chatgpt_3: Sign in with your sqemes account when ChatGPT asks.
mcpc_chatgpt_note: Your ChatGPT workspace’s policies decide whether custom MCP servers are allowed; on a business plan an admin may have to enable it.
mcpc_cc_1: Run the command below in your terminal.
mcpc_cc_2: In Claude Code, run /mcp, choose sqemes and sign in with your sqemes account.
mcpc_cc_note: Add --scope user to use it in every project. Without a browser, add --header "Authorization: Bearer $SQEMES_MCP_KEY" with a key instead.
mcpc_codex_2: Run codex mcp login sqemes and sign in with your sqemes account.
mcpc_codex_note: To use a key instead, add bearer_token_env_var = "SQEMES_MCP_KEY" to the table and set that variable.
mcpc_cursor_1: Create a key above and set it as the environment variable SQEMES_MCP_KEY.
mcpc_cursor_2: Add the block below to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in one project).
mcpc_cursor_3: Restart Cursor and switch the sqemes server on in its MCP settings.
mcpc_vscode_2: Add the file below as .vscode/mcp.json in your project (or in your user profile).
mcpc_vscode_3: Start the server from the file; VS Code asks for the key once and stores it.
mcpc_other_1: Add the endpoint URL above as a remote (HTTP) MCP server.
mcpc_other_2: If the client offers to sign in, do that. Otherwise send a key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
mcpc_other_note: Keep a file that holds a key out of version control.
mcpg_oauth: Signs in with your sqemes account — no key needed.

md_gemini_flash: Google's most intelligent Flash model — frontier-class quality at Flash speed. The default choice for chat, summarisation and extraction.
md_gemini_lite: Built for high-volume, low-latency work — classification, routing, bulk processing. 1M context window.
md_gemini_pro: Google's flagship reasoning model — deep reasoning and coding, stable. 1M context window.
md_openai_top: Advanced reasoning and coding — the one to reach for on hard problems.
md_openai_balance: Balanced intelligence and cost. The sensible default for everyday work.
md_openai_cost: Cost-optimised for high-volume workloads where throughput matters more than depth.
md_claude_deep: For demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. 1M context.
md_claude_recommended: Anthropic's recommended starting point — long-running coding and knowledge work. 1M context.
md_claude_balance: The best combination of speed and intelligence. 1M context.
md_claude_fast: For high-volume, latency-sensitive work such as classification, extraction and routing. 1M context.
md_grok: xAI's most capable model for code and chat, with real-time knowledge.
md_deepseek_fast: Highly efficient model rivaling top-tier proprietary models in coding and math. Exceptional value. 128K context.
md_deepseek_reason: Specialized reasoning model that thinks step-by-step. Competitive with top reasoning models at a fraction of the cost. 128K context.
md_mistral_large: State-of-the-art open-weight multimodal model with strong reasoning and multilingual capabilities. 128K context.
md_mistral_medium: Efficient model with strong multimodal performance. Great balance of speed and quality. 128K context.
md_mistral_code: Purpose-built for code completion and generation. Optimized for developer workflows. 256K context.
